events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on this day in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Chrissie Hynde as she turns 75 today! Her distinctive voice and fierce stage presence have made The Pretenders a true rock institution.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam G Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that swagger and unmistakable voice to the world of rock and roll.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring his signature title track, was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, and in the US on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album that gave us his timeless anthem of peace and unity.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod to the world on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit 1,000 songs in your pocket? Today marks the anniversary of Apple unveiling the first iPod, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: It's James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007, the enduring icon of style, espionage, and unforgettable theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, his unique brand of humour remains timeless.

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that pushed boundaries and still sounds incredible today.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead vocalist of Queen, who died at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His voice, showmanship, and legacy continue to rock the world. He would have been 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showcased their evolving artistry and songwriting prowess.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a legend. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless message of peace and love.
